text: Debugging is an important skill for every programmer. When a program does not work correctly, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find where the problem comes from and what causes it. Good debugging tools, such as breakpoints and error messages, can help you locate issues quickly. However, a systematic approach is even more important. Instead of changing code randomly, you should test one part at a time and check the results carefully. Logging is also very useful. By adding log messages to your code, you can see what the program is doing and find the exact point where something goes wrong. With patience and good strategies, you can solve most bugs efficiently.
